descriptionTemplate:
Session $sessionId has anomalous textual output: "$sessionOutput".
Expected session query: "$medoidOutput".
kgQuery: WITH s, sg, collect(DISTINCT outState.content) AS outContents, collect(DISTINCT medOut.content) AS medoidContents
coalesce(head([x IN outContents WHERE x IS NOT NULL]), '') AS sessionOutput,
coalesce(head([x IN medoidContents WHERE x IS NOT NULL]), '') AS medoidOutput
